item.title: Jaida Bristol joins lab
item.description: Welcome to Jaida Bristol, who joins the lab as part of the Cell Biology and Physiology Master’s program. She’ll spend this year working on chromatin and RNA interactions.

item.title: Claire Olson joins the lab
item.description: We’re glad to welcome Claire Olson, who joins the lab as a graduate student.

item.description: We’re glad to welcome Sophia Shultz, who joins the lab as an undergraduate researcher.

item.title: Margarita Dzama-Karels wins Pagano Award
item.description: Congratulations to Postdoctoral Scholar Margarita Dzama-Karels, who was awarded a 2026 Joseph S. Pagano Award for her 2025 paper, Menin-MLL1 complex cooperates with NF-Y to promote hepatocellular carcinoma survival. This annual award recognizes notable cancer-related papers authored by UNC Lineberger postdoctoral fellows.
